description: This file contains the implementation of the CachedGrainLocator class, which manages grain location lookups, registrations, and cache management within the Orleans distributed runtime. It interacts with grain directories, cluster membership, and handles cluster change events.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocator
classes.description: Implements grain location services with caching, cluster change listening, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocator.ITestAccessor
classes.description: Interface for accessing internal state for testing purposes, specifically the last membership version.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Performs a cache-optimized lookup for a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address with the directory, updating cache accordingly.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from cache and directory.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the locator to lifecycle events for startup and shutdown handling.

methods.name: ListenToClusterChange
methods.description: Listens for cluster membership updates and cleans up dead silos proactively.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a grain ID and silo address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries by grain ID or grain address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a grain address from cache, removing it if the silo is dead.
